lines: I am trying to belong here. Please do not make that harder.
Fine. We can start again from here, but not from before.
I am still figuring out where I fit. Please do not make me fit around fear.
Fine. I accept, but I need room to believe it.
That helps. Not everything, but it helps.
I do not have a profession for judging apologies. This one sounds real enough to start.
Let us call this a beginning, not a finish.
I will give the apology a place. Give me a reason to keep it there.
